title: Enzymatic pyrophosphate hydrolysis entangles pairs of phosphorus spins

statements.text: The enzyme-catalyzed reaction that breaks a pyrophosphate ion into two phosphate ions can quantum entangle the pair of phosphorus spins, and Posner molecules built from such pairs with calcium inherit the entanglement.

sources.quote: It is argued that the enzyme catalyzed chemical reaction which breaks a pyrophosphate ion into two phosphate ions can quantum entangle pairs of qubits
